title: CK Stands
description: Adds custom icons to the armour stand editing menu on CubeKrowd.
body:
This is a 1.21.5+ resource pack to be used on the CubeKrowd server. The pack Updates the UI for the Armour Stand Plugin to be much more visually intuitive.

![Customization menu with the pack's custom icons](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7d2684ed441ffddd507a98b938b38072a99c642e.png)

![Equipment customization sub menu with the pack's custom icons](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b5740f34ee4460e0c013a72561260781cedb408a.png)
